failures.criterion: Filter drift under the architect's conservative rule (comment 0c005b9d): a command the check accepts as a simple form must compile only what its filter covers. Three evasions are accepted as simple while the job compiles packages outside the filter
failures.evidence: reduce_line and env_reason (ci_filter_coverage.py:380-421) look only at the go line's own text and at env: blocks. The closure is always computed in the Run's workdir. (1) The step's working-directory (and defaults.run.working-directory) is never compared with Run.workdir. Real-tree probe: ci.yaml's test job, step 'Test the Go daemon' (`go test -count=1 -timeout 20m ./...`), with working-directory changed from packages/daemon to packages/envoy. check-ci-filters.sh exits 0 ('test: 3252 files, 0 uncovered'), though the job would then test every package of packages/envoy, and 171 of its 1138 non-infra .go files (e.g. packages/envoy/cmd/agent-secrets-devrelay/main.go) are outside the test filter. Edit reverted. (2) An earlier step that writes `GOFLAGS=-tags=probe` to $GITHUB_ENV holds no go command, so it is never read. The claimed line stays simple, yet go applies the tags. (3) `go env -w GOFLAGS=-tags=probe` on a line before the claimed command: go_lines takes only lines that match GO_COMMAND (test|vet|build|run|list|install|generate), so `go env -w` is never read, and go reads GOFLAGS from its env file. Red tests, commit dc1e05b6 on legion/INFRA-520, in .github/scripts/check-ci-filters.test.sh: 'a claimed simple go command whose step runs it in another directory' (working-directory mod -> alt, where alt/cmd/app and alt/lib exist outside the filter), 'an earlier step writes GOFLAGS to GITHUB_ENV before a claimed simple go command' and 'go env -w sets GOFLAGS before a claimed simple go command'. The last two each add a //go:build probe test importing example.com/m/other. Each expects exit 1 and a message naming alt, other/GITHUB_ENV or other/go env respectively. Command: `PATH=<python with PyYAML>:$PATH bash .github/scripts/check-ci-filters.test.sh` -> 'Results: 72 passed, 6 failed' (all three fixtures exit 0 today). A fix under the conservative rule, with no new parsing: count a claimed line as simple only when its step's working-directory (or job or workflow defaults.run.working-directory) equals the Run's workdir; otherwise the command falls to its module. Count every claimed command of a job as unreduced when any step of the job writes to GITHUB_ENV or runs `go env -w`.
